$comment: OpenCode Mobile design tokens, extracted from docs/ui/OpenCode Mobile - UI design.pdf.
Every hex here was SAMPLED from the rendered PDF pages at 150dpi, not eyeballed and not
copied from the old Material 3 mockups. The PDF is the source of truth; this file exists
so the palette is machine-readable and testable rather than living only in a screenshot.
dp scale: the PDF renders at 610px for a 393dp baseline viewport, i.e. 0.6443 dp/px.
The design shows DARK ONLY. There is no light palette in the source, so none is invented.
The PDF embeds a single subset font named 'Glyphless', so no real typeface metadata exists.
These roles are therefore read VISUALLY from the renders and must be treated as a close
approximation, not a measurement. Sizes are in sp; weights are Material/CSS-style 100-900.

shape.$comment: Primary actions are FULL CAPSULES (radius = height/2), measured from the FAB.

spacing.$comment: 4dp base grid. Derived from the PDF's measured margins and gaps.

elevation.$comment: The design has NO drop shadows. Depth is hairline borders plus surface lift.

motion.$comment: Inferred from the design's static states; see spec section 7 for the full list.
